welcome: Hello! I am your assistant. Ask me how to do something, what to do next, or what a term means.
welcome_note: Answers come from the product guide and your own to-dos. Nothing you type here is used to train a model.
error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
nudge: New: an assistant to help you
history_note: The conversation is kept in this browser tab only.
src_llm: Rephrased by AI from the product guide
disabled: The assistant has been switched off by your administrator.
cap_employee: I can help you: find how to do something (self-assessment, disputes, development plan, password…), tell you what is waiting for you, explain the page you are on, explain terms such as readiness, “not measured”, gap or IDP, and summarise YOUR OWN readiness and gaps. I never show other people’s data.
cap_manager: I can help you: find how to do something (reviews, coaching, IDP, PIP, 9-Box, reports…), list what is waiting for you, explain the page you are on and the key terms, summarise your own readiness, and answer questions about your team through the data copilot (aggregates, within your span). Answers about people are decision support only.
cap_admin: I can help you: find how to do something (campaigns, organisation, roles, imports, accounts, settings…), list what is waiting for you and the remaining setup steps, explain the page you are on and the key terms, and answer questions about your population through the data copilot (aggregates, within your scope).
fallback: I am not sure I understood. Try one of the suggestions below, or rephrase with a few keywords (for example “campaign”, “self-assessment” or “password”).
page_unknown: I have no specific guide for this page yet. The “Current page” and “Full manual” tabs may help, or ask me how to do something.
next_intro: Here is what is waiting for you:
next_none_employee: Nothing is waiting for you right now. A good next step: check that your self-assessment is up to date and look at your development plan.
next_none_manager: Nothing is waiting for you right now. A good next step: look at your team’s assessment coverage and at the gaps that matter most.
next_none_admin: Nothing is waiting for you right now. A good next step: check campaign progress and the assessment coverage of your scope.
setup_intro: Setting up the application: {{done}} of {{total}} required steps done. Still to do:
setup_step_roles: Create roles and set their requirements
setup_step_reviewers: Give everyone a supervisor or manager
self_readiness: Your role readiness is {{pct}} % over the {{assessed}} requirements assessed out of {{expected}}.
self_not_measured: Your readiness is not measured yet: none of your {{expected}} requirements has been assessed. Not measured is not 0 %.
self_no_role: No role requirements are set for you yet, so there is no readiness to show. Your administrator sets them on your role.
self_gaps: {{gaps}} measured gap(s), {{critical}} of them critical; {{unmeasured}} requirement(s) not measured yet.
self_admin: An administrator account has no personal assessment. Ask about your population instead, for example “What is the readiness by site?”.
data_denied: I can only show your own data, never other people’s. Ask “What is my readiness?” or “What should I do next?”.
copilot_unavailable: The data copilot could not answer just now. Please try again in a moment.
data_ai_off: Questions about your organisation’s data are answered by the AI copilot, which is switched off here. A SuperAdmin can switch it on under Administration → Modules. Meanwhile, the dashboard and the reports show the figures.
